typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	G_Dw_Run_Key as integer (),
	G_Run_EffDT_Temp as timestamp (),
	G_Run_EndDT_Temp as timestamp (),
	TempCard_Query as string ()
}

source(output(
		Intime as timestamp,
		Outtime as timestamp,
		TempHolderno as string,
		TempCardNo as string,
		ActualEmployeeName as string,
		ActualHolderNo as string,
		ActualCardNo as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT     dbo.STG_IOData.CardNo, HolderNo, HolderName, IODate, IOGateNo, IOTime, IOGateName, IOStatus, DepartmentNo, coalesce(dbo.TEmpCardData.EmployeeName,NULL) as EmployeeName,coalesce(dbo.TEmpCardData.CardNo,NULL) as TempCardNo FROM         dbo.STG_IOData  LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.TEmpCardData on dbo.TempCardData.CardNo = dbo.STG_IOData.CardNo AND dbo.TempCardData.IssueDate = dbo.STG_IOData.IODate',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DSRCSTGIODATA
DSRCSTGIODATA derive(D_DW_Run_Key = $G_Dw_Run_Key) ~> DerivedDwRunKey
DerivedDwRunKey sink(input(
		ActualEmployeeName as string,
		ActualCardNo as string,
		Intime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Outtime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ActualHolderNo as string,
		TempCardNo as string,
		D_DW_Run_Key as integer,
		TempHolderno as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ActualEmployeeName = Param_0,
		ActualCardNo = Param_1,
		Intime = Param_6,
		Outtime = Param_7,
		ActualHolderNo = Param_2,
		TempCardNo = Param_3,
		D_DW_Run_Key = Param_4,
		TempHolderno = Param_5)) ~> UpdateHolderNameinStgIOdataTable
